resources.label: The rights matrix
resources.description: Which access role may do what in which module. Editing this is how access is given to anyone, for anything — including access to this screen.

capabilities.label: Tick or clear a whole row or column at once

resources.label: Members
resources.description: The people provisioned by name. Granting someone a role here is how a person comes to hold rights at all.

capabilities.label: Suspend or restore a member without removing their roles

resources.label: Access roles
resources.description: The roles themselves, how membership of each is decided, and what inherits from what.

resources.label: Module registry
resources.description: Which modules exist, where they are served from, and whether they are public or granted.

capabilities.label: Re-read a module's manifest and reconcile orphaned grants

resources.label: Overrides
resources.description: Person-level exceptions. A deny here outranks every grant in the matrix.

capabilities.label: End an override now rather than waiting for its expiry

resources.label: Explain
resources.description: Why a given person can see a given thing. Reading it exposes what anyone holds, so it is grantable on its own.
